title: Receive before demanding more
summary: I have not fully appreciated what has already been given; mercy teaches the unworthy heart how to receive again. Honest gratitude becomes the doorway to mercy and Naam.
takeaway: Let honest gratitude become the doorway to mercy and Naam.
lifeApplication: Before complaining about what is missing, name one mercy already resting in the room and let it become praise.

source.shortMeaning: Mercy reaches the unworthy heart and restores the sight gratitude needs.
source.lifeApplication: Before complaint rises, name one mercy already holding the room together and let it become praise.

evidence.coreClaim: Mercy reaches the unworthy heart and restores the sight gratitude needs.
evidence.turn: Keep this in front of you: honest gratitude becomes the doorway to mercy and Naam.
evidence.practicalImplication: Before complaining about what is missing, name one mercy already resting in the room and let it become praise.
